verdict.rationale: The self-hosting docs say self-hosted Phoenix keeps data entirely within your infrastructure, sends nothing to Arize, and can be fully air-gapped. That implies a way to avoid vendor data collection. However, the pack documents no explicit telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out setting, and the guarantee is framed around trace data rather than product analytics. Missing for 10: a documented telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out flag or environment variable, clarity on whether the hosted or UI build collects usage analytics, and independent confirmation that no usage data is sent.
